_comment: The size ratchet for PRODUCT_SPEC.md (SPEC INV-264, Requirement 280). The bound is bytes-per-criterion: the byte count of the spec's criterion lines alone (glossary and preamble excluded) divided by the count of criteria in its body. A delivery may lower it or leave it; no delivery may raise it on its own (raising is a change to Requirement 280 itself, INV-265). The ratchet governs PRODUCT_SPEC.md only. A flat byte ceiling over the four working documents once composed with this ratchet as gate z (INV-234); that gate, its declaration, and guardrails/doc-bounds.json were retired whole 2026-08-18 as an unrequested bound.
reason: Raised 2026-08-19 to 185.8 — the lowest single-decimal bound the live spec clears. The live spec measures 185.7007 bytes per criterion over 1744 criterion rows, and the gate compares with a strict `>`, so 185.7 itself still reds (185.7 < 185.7007) and 185.8 is the lowest bound the current file clears. The bound stood at 185.6: the mirror-road cull retired Requirement 148 (3 criteria) and Requirement 304 (10 criteria) whole, and trimmed one criterion each from Requirement 147 and Requirement 198 (14 criteria gone in all, 1758 to 1744), and those fourteen criterion lines ran shorter than the spec's own average line — the same shape as the row-297 raise immediately before this one: a real structural cut, not bloat, raises the density of what remains even as the document itself shrinks. This raise is the deliberate Requirement-280-governed change INV-265 requires; a later delivery may lower this bound or leave it, and none may raise it without the same justification (INV-264, INV-265). Its history before this: raised 2026-08-19 to 185.6 (measured 185.5137 over 1758 criteria) when Requirement 297's eighteen leaner-than-average criteria retired; before that lowered 2026-08-17 to 185.4 (measured 185.3546 over 1771 criteria); before that 207.2, raised at the row-456 architecture-format landing (measured 207.196 over 1420 criteria) when six behavioral rules relocated from ARCHITECTURE.md into spec clauses (INV-279); before that seeded at the row-445 migration-end freeze and lowered by the freeze actor at the pass-2 re-baseline (206.9 over 1360 criteria; the pass-1 seed was 209.0 over 1301).
